messages.content: 將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？

function.name: thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure
function.description: Calculate gas pressure in a closed chamber due to heating Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

volume.description: The volume of the chamber in cubic meters. This is a float type value.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

initial_pressure.description: The initial pressure of the gas in Pascal. Default is standard atmospheric pressure. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
The user asks (in Chinese) "將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體?" They want how much gas will be produced? Actually they might mean what change in pressure occurs or maybe amount of gas generated? But likely they ask about gas pressure increase when heating from 25°C to 100°C in a sealed room with volume 2 m^3.

We have tool to calculate gas pressure given volume and temperatures. We can use ideal gas law assuming constant mass of air inside. So we need to compute new pressure using proportionality P/T if V constant. Use absolute temps: T1=298K, T2=373K. If initial pressure default ~101325 Pa. Then new pressure = P0 * T2 / T1 ≈ 101325*373/298 ≈ 126800 Pa (~127 kPa). Increase ~25kPa above atm.

Thus answer: Pressure increases to approx 127 kPa; difference ~26 kPa. Or produce no additional gas but increased pressure.

Let's call function.
